subject.title: bug: compaction preserves orphaned tool_use blocks after request timeout, permanently breaking session

question: Should OpenClaw compaction drop aborted assistant tool-call turns with no matching tool results, matching the existing prompt-send/replay sanitizer behavior, or should maintainers require a different recovery policy?
rationale: The linked fix is narrow and source-supported, but the durable product choice is whether losing the interrupted assistant turn is preferable to preserving or synthesizing context at compaction time.

options.title: Accept drop policy in the linked PR
options.body: Merge the candidate fix if checks remain clean, treating aborted orphaned tool-call turns as invalid compaction input that should be removed before strict-provider replay.

options.title: Pause for a synthesize policy
options.body: Hold the PR and design a provider-valid synthetic-result strategy if preserving the interrupted assistant turn is more important than minimizing fabricated context.

options.title: Reject this repair shape
options.body: Close the linked PR and keep this issue open only if maintainers want a different owner boundary or broader recovery design.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy in the linked PR
recommendation.body: Merge the candidate fix if checks remain clean, treating aborted orphaned tool-call turns as invalid compaction input that should be removed before strict-provider replay.
